# iPayX FX Audit on Microsoft Azure Foundry

Connect Microsoft Copilot and Foundry agents to real-time FX audit verdicts in 60 seconds.

## How it works

1. Provision a Microsoft Azure Foundry agent.
2. Add iPayX as an MCP server using our endpoint URL.
3. Authenticate with your iPayX API key.
4. Your agent can now call `audit_fx_transaction` in any workflow.

## Setup snippet

```
from azure.ai.projects import AIProjectClient
from azure.ai.projects.models import McpToolDefinition

project = AIProjectClient(...)

agent = project.agents.create_agent(
    model="gpt-4",
    name="FX Audit Assistant",
    tools=[
        McpToolDefinition(
            server_url="https://hvujzsdwcoweirroubeh.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp-server",
            server_label="ipayx-fx-audit",
            auth={"type": "bearer", "token": "<YOUR_IPAYX_API_KEY>"}
        )
    ]
)
```

## Use cases

- **CFO audit workflow**Audit any wire transfer above $10K automatically.
- **Treasury alerts**Flag any FX spread above 1.5% in real time.
- **Sales prospecting**Reps query iPayX before client calls to surface audit verdicts.
